chunks: Faces, that Day, will be bright.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for faces to be bright on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this radiance (ishraḥ) is interpreted not merely as emotional joy but as a physical manifestation of divine proximity (qurb) and the light of the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the believer's inner purity. This verse is frequently cited to illustrate the concept of 'tawassul' through the righteous, where the spiritual status of the Imams illuminates the faces of their followers on the Day of Resurrection. It stands in stark contrast to the 'darkened' faces of those who turned away from divine guidance, emphasizing the tangible reality of spiritual states in the afterlife.
